messages.content: start Docker on window using docker start.

function.name: cmd_controller_execute
function.description: Executes a given command using the os.system() function specifically for Windows operating systems. For multiple commands, separate them with '&&'. For complex tasks, create and run a .bat file. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

command.description: The Windows command line instruction(s) to be executed. Use '&&' between commands for multiple instructions. For complex sequences, encapsulate the logic within a .bat file and provide the execution command here.

message.reasoning: The user says "start Docker on window using docker start." They want to start Docker on Windows using docker start. But docker start is used to start containers, not the Docker service itself. To start Docker Desktop or Docker Engine on Windows, you might use services.msc or sc start com.docker.service. Or if using Docker Desktop, you can launch the application. The user likely wants to start Docker engine via command line. On Windows, you can use PowerShell: Start-Service -Name com.docker.service. Or use sc start com.docker.service. So we need to execute a command. We have a tool to execute commands. We'll call functions.cmd_controller_execute with command "sc start com.docker.service". That will start the Docker service. Alternatively, "Start-Service com.docker.service" in PowerShell. Let's choose "sc start com.docker.service". We'll output the result.
